name: Cezara Dracula
source:
The Would-be Divorcee

The second of Dracula's three Brides. Sick of how their husband treats them, they've wanted to see an attorney for a long, long time. Will they finally get their day in the sun?

Provide legal services to Cez as they divorce Dracula in the demonic court of law.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1712125696/draculesti]Kickstarter[/url]]
